gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-commissioner: Smooth curves that never clog and strokes of uniform thickness make Commissioner glide along. Commissioner is the quiet half here, while Pixelify Sans brings the bold, expressive display punch above it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-didact-gothic: Pixelify Sans draws its blocky letters with a steady line and a c as open as a bent paperclip. It handles the loud display work; Didact Gothic handles the smooth, modern reading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-dotgothic16: Pixelify Sans is the bold, expressive voice here, its line weight steady and its c wide open. DotGothic16 follows with tube-like strokes and generous channels into each counter, so the sans text stays approachable beneath the display type.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-doto: Pixelify Sans holds a pen-like line of constant weight, giving the headline a bold, expressive, unwavering look on the page. Doto answers with roomy margins around every glyph.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri has a faint swell in each curve, like pulled taffy, and a wide slot between the c's two ends. Pixelify Sans keeps its stroke width constant, so the headline feels bold and rigid while the sans text flows softly beneath it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-electrolize: Pixelify Sans lays down bold, expressive display letters with a steady stroke that stays as wide at the ends as in the middle. Then Electrolize enters with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, a modern sans partner.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans draws a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line, with a gap you can see through in each s. Yet Pixelify Sans gives the pair its edge, bold and expressive at display size with a line that never wavers.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans keeps its gaps wide enough that c never gets mistaken for o, so the text reads cleanly and neutrally. Pixelify Sans does the loud, outline-like display work; Encode Sans does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans-expa: Encode Sans Expanded reads approachably, its c shapes pulled well apart. Pixelify Sans brings a bold, constant stroke with no sparkle, so give the body font a little more size than you think it needs.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Chunky, bold, and unmistakably digital. Pixelify Sans holds a pencil-line consistency in its strokes, while Encode Sans SC brings shallow terminal curls and a wide gap, leaving the text professional and easy going beneath the display type.
